item.title: In their words: Left-leaning leaders in the Americas welcome Lula's victory in Brazil
item.description: Regional leaders across the Americas congratulated Brazilian President-elect Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on social media after he defeated opposition candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to win an unprecedented fourth term.

item.title: 9th Circuit questions DOJ demand to set aside 20,000 California mail ballots
item.description: A panel of federal appellate judges is questioning the Justice Department's demand that California election officials set aside thousands of mail ballots.

item.title: Attackers kill nurse, severely injure health worker responding to Ebola case in eastern Congo
item.description: The World Health Organization reports that a nurse has been killed and a health worker severely injured in an attack while responding to an Ebola alert in Congo.

item.title: Algeria to send troops to Niger in first foreign deployment in over 50 years
item.description: Algeria’s parliament has approved a resolution to send troops to Niger. This marks the first time since 1973 that Algerian soldiers will be deployed abroad.

item.title: Photos of NFL Week 7, from Steelers-Saints in Paris to Cowboys-Eagles
item.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers face the New Orleans Saints in Paris on Sunday in NFL Week 7. Other matchups include the Green Bay Packers at the Detroit Lions and the Kansas City Chiefs at the Seattle Seahawks.
